biotools.summary: iRRBS is a Python package designed to correct the 3' trimming of reduced representation sequencing (RRBS) reads, which can lead to false positive differentially methylated site (DMS) identifications. It improves RRBS analysis by identifying and hiding non-trimmed cytosines.
